Colour matrix: each row prices a sink with a tap chosen from three columns, one SP per row and column. Each column prints a Golden Yellow tap and a Full Rose Gold tap side by side with one SP; I paired the -GY sink with the -GY taps and the -RG sink with the -FRG taps (colour match inferred, not printed). SRTBK7005 (LP RM60) is joined by + to the whole matrix (printed beside row 3); copied to every sink. Sink prints LP only; BK004/BK002 Drainer LP RM180 printed under each sink.
